performance_continuity_contract.scale_method: Native anatomical and rigid-prop endpoints -> one uniform scale -> second independent landmark check; never fit pose height as anatomy.
performance_continuity_contract.relative_scale_authority: Named geometry artwork and persistent cross-chapter ratios; reconcile conflicting turnaround proportions before generating.
performance_continuity_contract.registration: Keep actor/prop world anchors and at least three room/floor landmarks fixed at same camera/depth unless the passage moves them.
performance_continuity_contract.camera_rule: Plan a motivated establishing/interaction/detail/emotional shot; genuine angle needs matching perspective sources. Reframe ALL physical layers and shadows together, preserve screen direction and painted border.
performance_continuity_contract.expression_rule: Each visible participant has named readable emotion, gaze recipient, brow/eye/mouth/head/gesture evidence at reading size.
performance_continuity_contract.grounding_rule: Verified actual bearing surfaces, one owner, attached low-alpha contact core and soft wash; no white gap; no shadows under imagined/airborne objects.
performance_continuity_contract.uniqueness_rule: Every page communicates its own text through action/response/meaningful view; no exact or cosmetic-only duplicate.
